title: Retire items, don't delete them
statement: Retire an item instead of deleting it, and record what it was merged into or is now covered by, so every change can be traced.
example: One standards workbook keeps its retired standards on a tab of their own, each marked with what it was merged into, covered by or rewritten as.
detail: A standards workbook's version summary lists its retired standards as preserved for traceability, and its retired tab marks each with what it was merged into, covered by or rewritten as (`downloads/5. Curriculum/Texts/Misconception and alignment checks/Social studies/Consensus social science standards.xlsx`). A count made in this run found the summary's 11 retired standards against 9 rows on that tab, so the trace itself has to be checked against its data.
